title: 第21章 反杀打劫人得了一匹老马第22章 云大顺一家搬走了
slug: 聚灵飞升第1126章暗流之下
content_zh:
云昊这是第二次碰到打劫的了。
第一次是四个流民。
这次居然还有骑马的蒙面人。
尽管是一匹干瘦老马。
可这已经很上档次了。
想了想云昊开口道：“那个……我板车上这些东西，你拿走，放我走成吗？”
能不动手，他是不想动。
这次的人，手里有刀，胯下骑马。
还真有点摸不准。
想着，舍弃一些物品，换个平安，也是可以的。
谁知道，对方沙哑大笑道：“小兔崽子，别以为大爷我不知道，你今日去杏林坊卖掉了人参和黄精，到手三十五两银子，还去了品味酒楼卖掉三头野猪，后来又去了狸猫巷黑市买了两粒气血丸。
本大爷也不为难你，交出三十五两银子和两粒气血丸，放你离开，否则大爷我宰杀了你，丢尸荒野。”
云昊听着蒙面人说话，心里一阵阵发寒。
又被盯上，扒干净了。
此人对自己在镇上的一切了如指掌。
甚至去了黑市都知道。
还真是出乎意料。
毫无疑问，这个蒙面人，是星河镇的人。
这是看自己年纪小，明目张胆欺负啊！
本想着舍弃一板车的物品，换个平安。

可对方根本不买账。
要自己身上的所有。
捏着砍柴刀，云昊冷声道：“别说我现在身上没有三十五两银子，就算是有，你一文钱也别想要，有什么本事就亮出来，我接着。”
他又不是第一次来镇上，更不是第一次碰到打劫。
人都杀过了，还在乎你一个骑着老马的鼠辈？
心气儿上来，云昊也是丝毫不惧。
蒙面人显然也没想到云昊会如此硬气，在马上一愣神。
随即勃然大怒：“小崽子既然求死，大爷就成全你。”
说罢，双腿夹击老马“驾”
了一声。
对着云昊举刀狠狠劈来。
云昊自然早有准备，看到对方出手就朝着自己脑袋砍下来。
心里不由一惊的同时，也是勃然大怒。
一出手就是奔着要命来的。
全身紧绷，手中砍柴刀用尽全力由下朝上砍出去抵挡。
小腹位置有气流流转全身。
浑身是力量的感觉，让云昊充满自信。
“咣当~”
content_en:
This is the second time Yun Hao has been robbed.
The first time there were four refugees.
This time there was actually a masked man riding a horse.
Even though he is a skinny old horse.
But this is already very high-end.
After thinking for a while, Yun Hao said: "Um... can you take these things on my cart and let me go?"
He didn't want to move if he could.
This time the person has a knife in his hand and a horse riding on his hip.
I'm really not sure.
I thought that it would be okay to give up some items in exchange for peace.
Who knew, the other party laughed hoarsely and said: "Little brat, don't think that I don't know, sir. Today you went to Xinglinfang and sold ginseng and Polygonatum japonica, and got thirty-five taels of silver. You also went to the Tasty Restaurant to sell three wild boars, and later you went to the black market of Civet Alley to buy two Qixue pills.
I will not embarrass you. I will hand over thirty-five taels of silver and two Qi-blood pills and let you go. Otherwise, I will kill you and throw your body into the wilderness. "
Yun Hao felt chills in his heart as he listened to the masked man talking.
He was targeted again and stripped clean.
This man knows everything about his town.
You even know it if you go to the black market.
It was really unexpected.
There is no doubt that this masked man is from Xinghe Town.
This is because I am young and blatantly bullied!
I thought about giving up a truckload of items in exchange for peace.
But the other party didn't buy it at all.
Want everything you have.
Holding the woodcutter, Yun Hao said coldly: "Don't tell me that I don't have thirty-five taels of silver with me now. Even if I do, don't even ask for a penny. If you have any skills, show them off and I'll take over."
It wasn't his first time in town, and it wasn't his first time being robbed.
You've killed everyone, why do you still care about you, a rat riding an old horse?
Yun Hao was not afraid at all when he was angry.
The masked man obviously didn't expect that Yun Hao would be so tough, and he was stunned on the horse.
Then he became furious: "Since you want to die, I will grant your wish."
After that, he hit the old horse with both legs and "drove"
There was a sound.
He raised his knife and struck Yun Hao hard.
Yun Hao was naturally prepared, and when he saw the opponent taking action, he chopped off his head.
I couldn't help being shocked, but also furious.
As soon as he takes action, he is rushing to kill him.
The whole body was tense, and the woodcutter in his hand was cut with all his strength from bottom to top to resist.
There is airflow in the lower abdomen that circulates throughout the body.
The feeling of strength all over his body made Yunhao full of confidence.
"Bang~"
